name: prefill-baseline

version.note: binary of the controller build printed at boot; --version fields not re-read (the installed engine was replaced by later builds)

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec none --prefix-cache off --no-vision --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

notes: Cold prefill medians of three kept passes (warm-up discarded, a unique prompt each pass), node-3 alone, SM clock locked at 2,200 MHz, SPEC none, PREFIX_CACHE off, VISION off, graphs on, chunk 4,096. The 3df40c1 isolation boot used REXL3_ALLOW_UNGATED_COMPONENTS=1. Profile: nsys -t cuda of the prefill_curve lab test on the same tree, not the server.
